execution_policy.quality: Do not reduce reasoning, verification, or implementation quality to save tokens. Save tokens only by excluding irrelevant context and repeated explanations.

tasks.title: Enforce the approved guide contract
tasks.goal: Turn the approved project-wide contract into machine-enforced invariants wherever that can be done safely, without changing slide wording or presentation behavior.
acceptance: Every REQ-* id in SSOT is referenced by at least one execution task and unknown requirement ids fail the audit.
The active TASK_CONTEXT contains the exact canonical requirements for its task without forcing a full SSOT read unless that task actually needs it.
Rules that can be represented safely in the data model or invariant tests are enforced there.
No existing owner-authored slide wording or presentation behavior is changed.
npm run check passes.
notes: Do not implement the new slides in this task.
Keep SSOT normative and concise; Git history is the historical record.

tasks.title: Extract reusable guide primitives
tasks.goal: Reduce regression risk by extracting only the recurring guide UI primitives from Guide.tsx while preserving behavior and visuals.
acceptance: Recurring flow, screenshot/hotspot, and branch-capable presentation primitives have one canonical implementation.
No owner-authored wording changes.
Existing slide IDs, navigation, screenshots, and hotspot behavior remain intact.
At least one existing dependent usage is regression-checked for each extracted shared primitive.
npm run check passes.

tasks.title: Add canonical two-path guidance
tasks.goal: Add a reusable responsive visual branch for procedures that genuinely have two paths, then use it for the approved student-task and space-opening cases.
acceptance: Two-path guidance is visibly split on desktop and mobile.
The student task flow shows both navigation through the space and a direct task URL path.
The direct-link path explicitly shows where the browser URL is copied from using real screenshots/hotspots.
The with-students/without-students choice is visually branched rather than text-only.
npm run check passes.

tasks.title: Teach later student joining by space link
tasks.goal: Show that a space opened without students can accept students later and teach the exact real link-copy path step by step.
acceptance: The guide explicitly states that choosing ללא תלמידים does not prevent adding students later.
The exact space URL location and copy action are shown, not merely described.
Every required click/action has a real screenshot and the established red focus marker when applicable.
Missing real evidence remains needs-capture rather than being mocked.
npm run check passes.

tasks.title: Make edit mode a first-class guide concept
tasks.goal: Create the approved edit-mode chapter structure and a real guide-side interactive on/off teaching control without pretending that the guide control is Moodle itself.
acceptance: A main topic asks מה זה מצב עריכה? before dependent editing procedures.
The guide clearly identifies operations that require edit mode.
The guide-side toggle is genuinely interactive and accessible, and visually distinguishes on/off.
The teaching control is not presented as a fake Moodle screenshot.
Real Moodle screenshots remain the evidence for the real Moodle control.
npm run check passes.

tasks.title: Complete the space-editing chapter
tasks.goal: Organize the approved editing procedures under a clear main heading and teach each procedure click by click.
acceptance: The chapter order teaches edit mode before edit-mode-dependent actions.
Separate procedures cover editing the main heading, main image, and task name.
Each procedure is complete, concise, screenshot-led, and marks the current target.
npm run check passes.

tasks.title: Add browser, visual, mobile and accessibility regression gates
tasks.goal: Protect the visual guide from regressions that typechecking and unit invariants cannot detect.
acceptance: Critical guide interactions are browser-tested.
Representative desktop and mobile states are regression-tested.
Two-path, hotspot, flow and edit-mode teaching states are covered.
Interactive controls expose appropriate accessibility semantics.
Fast checks remain fast; broad browser/visual gates run at appropriate checkpoints and CI.
npm run check passes.

tasks.title: Run final adversarial audit
tasks.goal: Attempt to prove that the completed implementation violates the SSOT, owner requirements, mobile behavior, truth rules, or regression guarantees; fix only verified findings.
scope: repository as required by verified findings
acceptance: Every canonical REQ-* requirement is checked against the final implementation, not merely against task completion state.
No unverified cleanup or speculative rewrite is performed.
All verified findings are fixed or explicitly blocked with evidence.
Full quality gate passes.
Task queue contains no unfinished approved requirement.
